text: Revenue metering: main and check meters of class 0.2S at the 380 kV connection point (dedicated instrument transformer cores of class 0.2 / 0.2S, IEC 61869), sealed, with energy data available to the TSO / market operator; RTU and telecommunication to the national dispatch centre (IEC 60870-5-104) with redundant links. Details in ALP-EPC-00000-EL-SPC-0003.
